nodes.summary: Let $X$ be a measurable real random variable on a probability space with $\mathbb{E}[X] = 0$ and $X^2$ integrable, and let $\varphi_X$ be the characteristic function of the law of $X$. Then for every real $t$, $|\varphi_X(t) - 1| \le t^2 \, \mathbb{E}[X^2]$.
nodes.title: Characteristic-function second-order bound

nodes.summary: Let $X$ be a measurable real random variable on a probability space with $|X|$ integrable, and let $\varphi_X$ be the characteristic function of the law of $X$. Then for every real $t$, $|\varphi_X(t) - 1| \le |t| \, \mathbb{E}|X|$.
nodes.title: First-order Taylor bound for the characteristic function

nodes.summary: Let $X$ be a measurable real random variable on a probability space with $X^2$ integrable, and let $\varphi_X$ be the characteristic function of the law of $X$. Then for every real $t$, $|\varphi_X(t) - 1 - it\,\mathbb{E}[X]| \le t^2 \, \mathbb{E}[X^2]$.
nodes.title: Second-order Taylor bound for the characteristic function

nodes.summary: For every real number $u$, $|e^{iu} - 1 - iu| \le u^2$, with no restriction on the size of $u$.
nodes.title: Global second-order bound for the imaginary exponential

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
